title: Crews are now Groups — boosts, banners and more
summary: Groups got a full upgrade: a real home page, levels you unlock together, and a pill on every member's profile.
changes: **Group pages** at infected.wtf/g/TAG with a banner, icon, about, links, members and stats
Your group shows as a **pill at the top of your profile** — tap it to see the members and jump to the group
**Boost** any group for 30 days to level it up — level 1 unlocks a profile strip, level 2 animated images, level 3 up to 100 members
Choose who can join: **open to all**, **ask to join** (you approve), or **invite only**
Upload your own **icon, banner and 350×19 profile strip**
Browse the top groups at infected.wtf/groups
